concerns.text: FR-008 requests a sensitivity analysis "sweeping the variance threshold over a range of high‑confidence levels (including lower, typical, and very high confidence levels)" but does not specify concrete threshold values or how many points in the sweep; without explicit numeric targets the requirement is not directly measurable.

SC-006 states that robustness will be measured by comparing TOST results across "a range of sensitivity analysis thresholds (moderate, high, and very high confidence levels)" without defining the actual confidence levels or corresponding variance thresholds, making the success criterion vague and untestable.

FR-010 requires analysis and logging of "loss landscape geometry (e.g., loss trajectory, convergence epoch)" but does not define the specific metrics, granularity, or logging format; this leaves the requirement open to interpretation and hampers automated verification.
